crossRefs.note: “Repent, for the Kingdom of Heaven is at hand!”
From that time, Jesus began to preach, and to say, “Repent! For the Kingdom of Heaven is at hand.”
He answered them, “To you it is given to know the mysteries of the Kingdom of Heaven, but it is not given to them.
He set another parable before them, saying, “The Kingdom of Heaven is like a grain of mustard seed, which a man took…
He spoke another parable to them. “The Kingdom of Heaven is like yeast, which a woman took, and hid in three measures…
He said, “What is God’s Kingdom like? To what shall I compare it?
“Listen! Behold, the farmer went out to sow,
and as he sowed, some seed fell by the road, and the birds came and devoured it.
The farmer sows the word.
Wicked people earn deceitful wages, but one who sows righteousness reaps a sure reward.
He who observes the wind won’t sow; and he who regards the clouds won’t reap.
In the morning sow your seed, and in the evening don’t withhold your hand; for you don’t know which will prosper…
Does he who plows to sow plow continually? Does he keep turning the soil and breaking the clods?
Blessed are you who sow beside all waters, who send out the feet of the ox and the donkey.
He spoke to them many things in parables, saying, “Behold, a farmer went out to sow.
He set another parable before them, saying, “The Kingdom of Heaven is like a man who sowed good seed in his field,
“The farmer went out to sow his seed. As he sowed, some fell along the road, and it was trampled under foot, and the…
Now the parable is this: The seed is the word of God.
He who reaps receives wages and gathers fruit to eternal life; that both he who sows and he who reaps may rejoice…
Most certainly I tell you, unless a grain of wheat falls into the earth and dies, it remains by itself alone. But if it…
I planted. Apollos watered. But God gave the increase.
Now the fruit of righteousness is sown in peace by those who make peace.
having been born again, not of corruptible seed, but of incorruptible, through the word of God, which lives and remains…

translations.web: He said, “God’s Kingdom is as if a man should cast seed on the earth,
translations.bsb: Jesus also said, “The kingdom of God is like a man who scatters seed on the ground.
translations.kjv: And he said, So is the kingdom of God, as if a man should cast seed into the ground;
translations.asv: And he said, So is the kingdom of God, as if a man should cast seed upon the earth;
